bahrain.title: Eskan Bank plans more than 2,000 homes at Al Saya in Muharraq
bahrain.summary: Eskan Bank has launched Al Saya Greens, a mixed-use project of nearly 560,000 square metres with 1,065 apartments, 971 villas and a commercial boulevard built around the historic Ain Al Saya spring. Dar Al Khaleej Engineering won the tender for the master plan and infrastructure designs.

bahrain.title: Brent crude passes $101 as China cancels fuel export shipments
bahrain.summary: Brent rose 3.7 per cent to about $101.66 a barrel and WTI gained 2.3 per cent to $92.53 after Chinese state oil firms reportedly cancelled October gasoline and jet fuel cargoes to protect domestic stocks. Extra Saudi shipments through the Red Sea port of Yanbu limited the rise.

bahrain.title: Ministries ready drainage and emergency teams for the rainy season
bahrain.summary: The municipalities and works ministers reviewed plans for handling rainwater with the Capital and municipal councils. Emergency teams now cover all four municipal areas, while the Works Ministry is cleaning and maintaining drainage networks and preparing pumps and tankers.

bahrain.title: MP calls for more student buses and lower fares for university travel
bahrain.summary: MP Dr Mariam Al Dhaen wants more public buses and closer stops for the University of Bahrain and Bahrain Polytechnic, and a review of the BD 12.000 monthly fare. Private student transport costs about BD 60.000 a month, and a councillor wants the Sakhir campus eastern gate reopened to cut queues of up to 40 minutes.

bahrain.title: ASB Capital and StepStone launch Sharia-compliant private financing fund
bahrain.summary: ASB Capital, which manages $10.2 billion, has partnered with StepStone to launch an open-ended fund focused mainly on senior secured financing to mid-sized US companies. It marks the firm's expansion into private markets for investors seeking Sharia-compliant income.

bahrain.title: Al Salam Bank first to adopt JP Morgan's overnight Murabaha service
bahrain.summary: Al Salam Bank says it is the first bank globally to implement JP Morgan Payments' Overnight Murabaha solution, launched in 2026. The tool lets banks earn Sharia-compliant overnight returns on balances held in their nostro accounts with JP Morgan.

bahrain.title: Three-year sentence for hiding divorce to obtain family visa
bahrain.summary: The High Criminal Court sentenced a 65-year-old Bahraini in absentia to three years in prison for giving false information to the NPRA. He obtained a two-year family visa for his former wife in 2023 by concealing that they had divorced years earlier, avoiding additional fees.

bahrain.title: Al Baraka Group shareholders approve $12.43 million cash dividend
bahrain.summary: Al Baraka Group's ordinary general meeting approved a cash dividend equal to 1 per cent of issued share capital, or $0.01 per share, subject to regulatory approvals. The chief executive said it reflects the group's performance and liquidity.

crypto.title: Circle asks EU to drop bank deposit minimums for stablecoin reserves
crypto.summary: In its response to the European Commission's MiCA review, Circle called for replacing the rule that issuers hold 30 to 60 per cent of reserves in bank deposits with a flexible liquidity requirement, a position it shares with the European Central Bank. It also wants cross-border co-issuance preserved.

crypto.title: South Korea sets out detailed rules for tokenized securities
crypto.summary: The Financial Services Commission proposed rules letting stocks, bonds and funds be issued and traded as tokens from 4 February 2027. Issuers managing customer accounts would need 4 billion won ($2.8 million) in capital, and retail buyers would be capped at 100 million won a year per OTC exchange. Consultation runs to 11 November.

crypto.title: Anchorage Digital reported to have cut 17 per cent of its staff
crypto.summary: The Information reports that the US chartered crypto bank, valued at $4.2 billion earlier this year, told employees of the cuts this week. With about 400 staff in February, that would be roughly 68 jobs. Anchorage has not confirmed the report.

crypto.title: South Korean crypto exchange profits fall 78 per cent in first half
crypto.summary: Government data shows operating profits at South Korea's exchanges dropped 78 per cent in the first half of 2026. Average daily trading volume fell 44 per cent from the previous six months and won deposits fell 35 per cent, amid signs retail investors are moving to the stock market.

crypto.title: Core Lightning tells node operators to upgrade as attackers target old versions
crypto.summary: The team behind the Bitcoin Lightning Network node software urged anyone running version 26.06.7 or earlier to update immediately after reports of attacks on unpatched nodes. A release on 22 September fixed several flaws, including one that could cause users to lose funds.

crypto.title: Payments firm OpenPayd aims for Nasdaq listing by year end
crypto.summary: The London-based fiat and stablecoin payments provider expects its merger with Titan Acquisition Corp. to close this year, subject to SEC and shareholder approval. It plans a US launch by April 2027 after acquiring 43 state money transmitter licences, and reported revenue of $73 million.
